thread:
sara: Heads up team 1:00 UTC change window for terraform apply: small routing change + iam trust update. This is a multi-wave cutover with a staged state promotion. Plan uploaded to the ops bucket. Please ack if you can be available for a 90m window.

vik: I can be on for the first hour. What's the provider pin? Any module upgrades?

sara: Provider pinned to hashicorp/aws = 3.6.0 in the root module to avoid a provider selector drift. We are not bumping any modules other than a tiny route table change in network-routing. No runtime module upgrades.

leah: I'll run canary in eu-west-1 and validate cross-account assume-role paths. If canary looks good, deploybot will proceed with wave1 in us-west-2 then us-east-1.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled apply job 1716419999 created by @sara. Canary: eu-west-1 -> wave1 us-west-2 -> wave2 us-east-1. Provider: hashicorp/aws 3.6.0. State snapshot will be stored at s3://redwood-tf-state/backups/network/1716419999.tfstate.

ops-bot: Note: remote state lock acquired by sara (lock id: a2b4c8), TTL 45m.

dan: Quick preflight: export plan and save json. Command I ran:
```
terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars -out=apply.plan
terraform show -json apply.plan > apply.plan.json
aws s3 cp apply.plan.json s3://redwood-tf-plans/1716419999.json
```
Also ran `tfsec` on the plan. No findings.

leah: Canary started. Running apply now. I'll ping here in 8m with smoke results.

deploybot: deploybot: canary apply in progress (eu-west-1). Logs: https://deploy-logs.internal/1716419999/canary

leah: Canary finished 1:08 UTC. Health checks ok, assume-role tests succeeded, a single instance rebooted during apply but recovered. Synthetic auth tests passed. No 5xx.

vik: Monitoring dashboards now. Thresholds to abort: 1) 5xx > 2% for 5m, 2) connection errors in peering > 50 per 5m, 3) any failing IAM assume-role test. If any abort, follow rollback steps.

sara: Rollback quick steps I added to the runbook:
1) Pause deploybot run (abort remaining waves).
2) If state drift detected, restore state from s3 snapshot created pre-run (see path above).
3) If apply partially completed, run manual reconcile on affected routes only.
4) Open a high-priority incident and call infra-oncall.

ops-bot: Reminder: snapshot created s3://redwood-tf-state/backups/network/1716419999.tfstate and an additional compressed copy at s3://redwood-tf-state/backups/network/1716419999.tfstate.gz

deploybot: deploybot: wave1 apply started (us-west-2).

leah: Wave1 applied ok. Wave2 scheduled in 12m. No changes to IAM in wave1.

dan: Post-apply checklist: run `terraform state list` and `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod` to validate route targets. Also check peering connection status.

vik: Noticed a small spike in NAT gateway creation times but nothing impacting traffic. Keeping eyes on packet drop metrics.

deploybot: deploybot: wave2 apply succeeded. All waves complete.

leah: Post-apply smoke OK. Verified assume-role flows. Synthetic traffic steady.

sara: Thanks team. I'll add a one-paragraph release note for Monday: "Network routing tweak and cross-account IAM trust updated to support new billing exporter. Applied with provider pin 3.6.0; no module upgrades. No user-visible impact."

ops-bot: Lock released for run 1716419999.

dan: I'll attach the plan json and a short diff to the release notes doc.

vik: Good run. Small follow-up: create a ticket to track provider unpin in a few weeks after smoke in staging.

sara: Added ticket #INFRA-492 to backlog. Closing thread.
